column1: # Energy Research Warehouse (ERW): the battery model's hourly dispatch; the default case of /cost-of-power/battery (session 178)

# Case: ERCOT; energy at HB_HUBAVG; a 4-hour battery; strategy foresight (energy at the hourly mean of the real-time price; ancillary services at day-ahead clearing prices); round trip 0.86; per 1 MW of rated power
# Window: local (Central) months 2023-10 to 2026-09; the 36 months of the page's bad month. in_last_twelve = 1 marks 2025-10 to 2026-09; the page's last twelve months
# Rows: one per local hour of every day the model solved; a local day holds 24 hours; 23 on the spring daylight-saving day; 25 on the autumn one. hour_of_day counts from 0 within the local day

# Prices: price_energy_usd_mwh in USD per MWh; price_<product>_usd_mw in USD per MW for the hour. Decisions per MW of rated power: charge_mw and discharge_mw at the grid; soc_mwh the stored energy at the end of the hour; award_<product>_mw

# Revenue: USD per MW of rated power for the hour; revenue_energy_usd = price x (discharge - charge); revenue_<product>_usd = price x award; revenue_ancillary_usd their sum; revenue_total_usd energy plus ancillary. switch_used = 1: the day needed the charge-or-discharge switch
# Sentinel: -999 in a product's price; award and revenue columns means the product was not bought on that day. Days left out by the model (an hour of a price not held): 0
# Source tables (ERW; warehouse/output): iso_rtm_hub_prices and ercot_all_hub_prices_history; ercot_as_prices; battery_stack_monthly (the window and the check below)

# Retrieved (UTC) as each table's own header states: iso_rtm_hub_prices 20261008T141137Z; ercot_all_hub_prices_history 20260926T000958Z; ercot_as_prices 20261008T150758Z; battery_stack_monthly 20261005T010314Z

# Model: warehouse/derived/battery_stack.py; sha256 db11bcfd4d9a8f928c7d8812f5a6c2ce1409d4796b4858ade923f0ded52294d7; last changed by commit 1a6e61f3dbecbfc857c2415cb47ec6400f77ef9a. Every day here is solved by its solve_day and passes its check_day
# Check at export: each month's sums of these hours equal the rows of battery_stack_monthly to within 0.005 USD per MW (36 months; 1096 days; 1 days used the switch)
# License: public. Derived by the ERW from ERCOT's public prices (https://www.ercot.com/help/terms). Not a forecast; not what any battery earned: an upper bound under perfect foresight
# Stata: import delimited using erw_2026_battery_dispatch.csv; varnames(15) rowrange(16) stringcols(_all). These comment lines hold no comma and no double quote
